label: Product
description: A product: the root of a set of specifications.

label: Domain
description: A part of the product with its own model, language and owner.

label: Aggregate
description: A cluster of records changed together as one unit, with its own identity and rules.

label: Domain rule
description: A fact that must always hold for an aggregate's records, whatever use case changes them.

label: Use case
description: Something an actor does with the product to reach a goal.

label: Requirement
description: One rule a use case must follow, stated with MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD or MAY.

label: Flow
description: An end-to-end path through views and endpoints that carries out one or more use cases.

label: View
description: A screen or page a person uses.

label: Endpoint
description: An HTTP endpoint: its method, route, request and responses.

label: Component
description: A unit of code in the target design, such as a model, service or router.

label: Test
description: A test that proves requirements or domain rules, and the file that runs it.

label: Open question
description: Something undecided, with the person who decides it.
